title: 26 U.S.C. 6072, Time for filing income tax returns (U.S. Code 2024 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, United States Code

passages.question: What does the statute itself say about a fiscal-year partnership due date?
passages.excerpt: such returns made on the basis of a fiscal year shall be filed on or before the 15th day of the third month following the close of the fiscal year.
